description: This file defines the TemplateAddress class used for handling address fields within the SuiteCRM dynamic fields module. It includes methods for saving address-related data, handling label parsing, and managing address field attributes.

classes.name: TemplateAddress
classes.description: A class extending TemplateField to manage address fields in dynamic forms, including saving label information and address components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving address field data, including label processing and setting up individual address components such as City, State, PostalCode, and Country.
